name: image-pdf-to-pptx
title: Image-only slide PDF → editable PPTX
description: Convert an image-only or scanned slide PDF into a fully editable PowerPoint .pptx by measuring the raster and rebuilding it as native shapes and text boxes. Icons and the backdrop are the only raster left in the result.

useCase.query: Convert this slide PDF to an editable PPTX. It has no text layer — rebuild the layout, fonts, colours, icons and card translucency as native PowerPoint shapes and text boxes, then verify by rendering the result back and diffing it against the source.
